# Indusolutions

Client. A specialist transport and logistics business in Kenwick, Western Australia - concrete panel transport on PrefaMAX trailers, drop deck and refrigeration - serving builders, precast and civil clients in Perth and regional WA. It has its own IT department, which manages its domain and email. Per the [quote brief](../../sources/2026/10/2026-10-28-indusolutions-quote-brief.md) and the [clarifications excerpt](../../sources/2026/10/2026-10-28-indusolutions-clarifications-answers.md). Part of a company group of about nine businesses called Malbros (spelled so in Camille's 2026-11-24 email; heard as "Melbras" on 2026-11-09), which includes [Gascoyne Haulage](gascoyne-haulage.md); Camille is also pitching another business in the group (not yet identified). [transcript](../../sources/2026/11/2026-11-09-meeting-camille-madz-transcript.md) Contact person not yet known. Spelled **Indusolutions**.
